en: The image depicts a vintage outdoor restaurant terrace with many tables and chairs, surrounded by lush vegetation and a charming building overgrown with vines. Two women in historic dress stand in the foreground. The style and sepia tone suggest an early 20th-century setting. Printed text in red reads 'Curhaus-Restauration Eggenberg b. Graz', with an additional stamp marked 'STEIERM. LANDES ARCHIV' and the year 1903.
